description: This custom map is ideal for any Global Information System (GIS) or any other user who has data related to Grids. No more complex post-processing, It delivers very easy and performant data visualization with all capabilities of Microsoft Power BI for data interactivity and data analytics. The easiest way to visualize raster-data professionally. Introductory details of our custom visual, a powerful tool designed for precise geospatial mapping and data visualization of raster data. This tool allows users to create interactive custom polygons using corner points, enabling the creation of square or quadrilateral shapes anywhere in the world. It can display centroids (latitude and longitude) on the top layer of the polygons, providing a clear and concise view of your data. It accepts various open AreaSeals (OAS), 4-point shapes as geo-spatial data-equivalents, input fields such as centroids/center points (x, y), polygon inputs (4 corner points x, y), legend, bubble size, and tooltip. Value Proposition: Are you a GIS user or someone working with grid-related data? Simplify your data visualization and analysis with Smart Grid-Map. Say goodbye to complex post-processing and experience the power of precise geospatial mapping in Microsoft Power BI.
